title: Megurine Luka — Fluffy Dream Wedding〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's so nice out again today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's the perfect day for a little snooze.
If I don't, the deity of napping is sure to punish me♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, nighty night...
*Sigh*
You're sighing again.
I mean...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Nene and the others.
They must have finished practice.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka!
Hello!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Were you taking another nap today?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, because it's so nice out.
It's so sunny, smiley and sleepy♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But Nene, you don't look so good...
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, uhh... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? You're going to work part-time all by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm worried because I don't really know anyone there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You'll do fine, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree! I mean, you did the night show, a show with Asahi and his troupe, practiced with Shunmeiza and helped make a film!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've gained the strength to make this work, Nene. All that's left is for you to take a shot in the dark!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What if I miss...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Nene seemed to be feeling a little better after hearing her friends show their support, but I'm still sensing no small amount of anxiety...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
The weather's so nice...
But I don't feel sleepy at all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aha☆ There you are, Luka♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank goodness♪ Do you have time to talk about our next show?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm free to talk...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You seem a little down.
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. Which is why you're worried about Nene...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, she did look a bit anxious before we even started practicing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But I get how she feels.
I mean, no one she knows is gonna be there, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's scary not knowing if you'll be able to make friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I think she's gonna do just fine♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree.
If anything, she should be worrying about...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Becoming so nervous during the day of that she freezes up. Even though she should do just fine, her anxiety may prevent her from doing so...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If she feels nervous already, it might be even worse when the actual day comes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Right.
Can't we do anything for her?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course we can☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You just gotta go visit her that morning, Luka, and give her anxiety the old fluffy-duffy-cuddly-wuddly-sockatooey♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The old fluffy-duffy-cuddly-wuddly-sockatooey?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe she's trying to say that you should go over and show your support by visiting her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're the softest and cuddliest out of all of us, Luka. So, you should use your powers to help Nene relax♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's a wonderful thought.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But wouldn't MEIKO or KAITO do a better job of cheering her on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, we could take your place.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I think you're the one who wishes to help Nene the most out of all of us right now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. I believe you're the best person for the job, Luka. Especially since you've already talked to her about it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, I'll go visit Nene and give her anxiety the old fluffy-duffy-cuddly-wuddly-sockatooey♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, now you just need to make sure to be awake the day you're supposed to go see her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That won't be a problem♪
I have you to wake me up, don't I, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I had a feeling you'd say that.
If push comes to shove, I'm really going to shove, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel so much better now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She fell asleep...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did all that thinking tire her out?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe we should wait to talk about our next show...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sounds good!
